questions.stem_en: A company with 40 accounts in AWS Organizations runs managed nodes in four Regions. The company wants one central patching configuration for all of them, with a daily scan for missing patches and a separate weekly schedule for installing patches. Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

choices_en.text: Create a maintenance window in each account and Region, and register a patching task with the scan and install schedules.
Create one Patch Manager patch policy in Quick Setup for the organization, with separate scan and install schedules.
Add cron jobs to every node that check for updates every day and install them every week.
Ask each account owner to scan and patch their nodes by hand and report the results every week.

explanation.summary: AWS はパッチ適用の設定にパッチポリシーを使うことを勧めています。パッチポリシーは Quick Setup で作る設定で、AWS Organizations を使えば、すべてのアカウントのすべてのリージョンのマネージドノードに 1 つのパッチポリシーを当てられ、スキャンとインストールで別のスケジュールを決められます。

per_choice.A: 動きますが、40 のアカウントと 4 つのリージョンのそれぞれで設定を作って保守する必要があります。
per_choice.B: 正しい。1 つの設定で組織全体に当てられ、スキャンとインストールのスケジュールも分けられます。
per_choice.C: 各ノードの設定を保守する必要があり、中央の設定になりません。
per_choice.D: 手作業が多く、中央の設定になりません。

references.quote: However, if you use AWS Organizations, you can set up one patch policy that applies to all your managed nodes in all AWS Regions in all your AWS accounts.
Using a patch policy, you can specify different schedules for scanning and installing.
Using patch policies is the recommended method for configuring your patching operations.

questions.stem_en: A company's security policy says that critical operating system updates must be applied, but only after they have been publicly released for one week, so that the company can watch for problems reported by others. New critical updates are released several times each month. Which solution meets this requirement with the LEAST operational effort?

choices_en.text: Edit the predefined patch baseline so that it waits 7 days before approving critical updates.
Create a custom patch baseline with an approval rule for critical updates that uses an auto-approval delay of 7 days.
Create a custom patch baseline with an approval rule that uses a fixed patch approval cutoff date, and update the date by hand every week.
Have an engineer review new critical updates every week and approve each one by hand.

explanation.summary: 独自のパッチベースラインでは、どのパッチを承認するかをより細かく決められ、承認ルールごとに自動承認の遅延か承認の締め切り日を指定できます。自動承認の遅延は、パッチが公開されてから自動で承認されるまで待つ日数です。事前定義のベースラインはそのまま使うもので、変えられません。

per_choice.A: 事前定義のパッチベースラインは変えられません。
per_choice.B: 正しい。公開から 7 日たった重要な更新が、手作業無しで自動で承認されます。
per_choice.C: 締め切り日を毎週手作業で動かす必要があり、手間がかかります。
per_choice.D: 毎週の手作業が必要です。

references.quote: An auto-approval delay is the number of days to wait after the patch was released or last updated, before the patch is automatically approved for patching.
You can use these baselines as they are currently configured (you can't customize them) or you can create your own custom patch baselines.
For each approval rule that you create, you can choose to specify an auto-approval delay or specify a patch approval cutoff date.

questions.stem_en: Installing patches during business hours has caused outages. The company now wants disruptive updates on a group of managed nodes to run only on Sunday between 02:00 and 05:00. Before patching, a Lambda function must remove the nodes from a load balancer, and then a Run Command task must install the patches. Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

choices_en.text: Create a Sunday maintenance window with a maximum duration, the nodes as targets, and the Lambda and Run Command tasks.
Create a State Manager association that runs the patch document every Sunday on the nodes.
Add a cron job on each node that removes itself from the load balancer and installs patches on Sunday.
Ask an on-call engineer to run the Lambda function and the Run Command task by hand every Sunday morning.

explanation.summary: メンテナンスウィンドウは、OS のパッチ適用のような止まる可能性のある操作をいつ行うかのスケジュールを決めるもので、スケジュール・最大の長さ・登録したターゲット・登録したタスクを持ちます。タスクには Run Command のコマンド、Automation のワークフロー、Lambda の関数などを使えます。State Manager は構成の準拠を自動にするのに向き、決めた時間帯の優先度の高い作業にはメンテナンスウィンドウを選びます。

per_choice.A: 正しい。決めた時間帯の中だけで、Lambda と Run Command のタスクを順に動かせます。
per_choice.B: 構成の準拠を保つための仕組みで、最大の長さを持つ時間帯の中で複数の種類のタスクを動かす要件に合いません。
per_choice.C: 各ノードの設定を保守する必要があり、手間がかかります。
per_choice.D: 毎週の手作業が必要です。

references.quote: Maintenance Windows helps you define a schedule for when to perform potentially disruptive actions on your nodes such as patching an operating system
Each maintenance window has a schedule, a maximum duration, a set of registered targets (the managed nodes or other AWS resources that are acted upon), and a set of registered tasks.
Which one you choose depends on whether you need to automate system compliance or perform high-priority, time-sensitive tasks during periods you specify.

questions.stem_en: A security advisory lists a vulnerable version of a third-party agent. The company runs 2,000 managed nodes and must quickly find which nodes have that version installed, and must keep doing this check for future advisories. The company does not want to log in to nodes or write collection scripts. Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

choices_en.text: Use Systems Manager Inventory to collect metadata from the nodes into a central Amazon S3 bucket, and query it with the built-in tools.
Use Patch Manager compliance reports to find which nodes have the vulnerable agent version installed.
Write a Run Command script that lists installed software on each node and writes the output to a bucket for analysts to search.
Have engineers sign in to each node and check the agent version by hand.

explanation.summary: Systems Manager Inventory は、マネージドノードからメタデータを集めて、AWS の環境を見えるようにします。集めたメタデータを中央の S3 バケットに保存し、組み込みのツールでクエリすれば、どのノードが決まったソフトウェアや構成を動かしているか、どのノードを更新する必要があるかを素早く見分けられます。

per_choice.A: 正しい。スクリプト無しでメタデータを集め、今後の勧告でも同じクエリで確かめられます。
per_choice.B: Patch Manager の準拠は、パッチベースラインで承認したパッチが入っているかを示すもので、サードパーティのエージェントのバージョンを探す仕組みではありません。
per_choice.C: 動きますが、収集のスクリプトを書いて保守することになり、要件に反します。
per_choice.D: 2,000 台への手作業は時間がかかり、要件に反します。

references.quote: You can use Inventory to collect metadata from your managed nodes.
use built-in tools to query the data and quickly determine which nodes are running the software and configurations required by your software policy, and which nodes need to be updated.
A managed node is patch compliant when it is up to date with all the patches that meet the approval criteria that you specify in the patch baseline.
